title: Activation Checklist — Specialty Pharmacy Program Enrollments
content:
A Specialty Pharmacy Program enrollment is activated only when **all** of the following hold on the activation date:

- [ ] the member's Pharmacy Benefit Plan enrollment is active, or is under COBRA continuation;
- [ ] the drug is covered on the member's formulary, or an exception approval for the drug is in force;
- [ ] when the member's utilization management program requires a coverage review for the drug, an approval for that drug is in force;
- [ ] the member has agreed to enroll.

An enrollment can be activated only when a coverage review approval for the drug is in force whenever the member's program requires one. The approval is shown by the member's coverage review authorization records for that drug, with their effective and expiration dates. These system records are checked for this enrollment before activation.

## Around activation

- Where the tier provides for a pharmacist consultation before the first shipment of a new therapy, that consultation is completed before the first shipment.
- Injectable therapies get the tier's number of injection training nurse visits.
- The onboarding call is made within the tier's onboarding-call business days after activation.

## Combinations

Because activation needs every item, one unmet item is enough to prevent it.

| Plan enrollment active or COBRA continuation | Drug on formulary or exception approval in force | Coverage review approval in force where one is required | Member agreed to enroll | Activated? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes, or no review required | Yes | Yes |
| No | Yes | Yes, or no review required | Yes | No |
| Yes | No | Yes, or no review required | Yes | No |
| Yes | Yes | Review required, no approval in force | Yes | No |
| Yes | Yes | Yes, or no review required | No | No |

## Point of judgement

*A drug needs a coverage review under the member's utilization management program, and the review case is still open with no approval.* No approval is in force, so the enrollment cannot be activated.
